column1: # Session 13 pass 4 — evidence harvest for the 70 new candidates from pools D/E/F PLUS the 52 review-queue
# backlog candidates that carry a Q-ID (union = 122 Q-IDs), so the backlog is re-tested against exactly the same
# evidence standard rather than left to age.
# Query: data/research/urls/evD_ord0.url and evD_ord150.url (4-branch UNION, ORDER BY ?row, LIMIT 150),
# executed 2026-09-06. Page OFFSET 0 returned 150 rows, page OFFSET 150 returned 45 rows (< LIMIT) -> complete,
# 195 rows total, transcribed verbatim. Markdown escapes removed (\_ -> _, %27 kept as returned in URLs).
#   S = named source on the date-of-birth reference (pr:P248 label); "NONE" = a reference exists carrying neither a
#       named source nor a URL -> NOT age evidence (docs/verification-protocol.md line 92)
#   U = reference URL on the date-of-birth statement (pr:P854)
#   W = English Wikipedia article linked to the item (schema:about + schema:isPartOf en.wikipedia.org)
#   N = label of a member-of team (P54) whose country is the United States (wdt:P17 wd:Q30) and whose English label
#       contains "volleyball" — used only to document college-team membership; national teams and professional
#       leagues inside that set are distinguished by the generator, never assumed to be colleges
# Transcription conventions (identical to pass 3, documented so nothing is silently altered):
#   * rows of the form S|~<url> are omitted because the identical URL is already recorded on the U line;
#   * exactly repeated rows (e.g. two identical S|~ rows for one item) are recorded once;
#   * a named source with no URL is recorded with the trailing "~" stripped (e.g. "FIVB database").
# IDENTITY / SPORT CONFLICTS observed in this harvest — recorded verbatim above and handled by the generator, never
